summary.en: Log-based Change Data Capture pipeline from PostgreSQL to Greenplum. Median 14.6 s until a change is visible in Greenplum, versus a daily batch ETL; 15-second micro-batch, not direct streaming.
summary.id: Pipeline Change Data Capture berbasis log dari PostgreSQL ke Greenplum. Median 14,6 dtk sampai perubahan terlihat di Greenplum, dibandingkan batch ETL harian; micro-batch 15 dtk, bukan streaming langsung.

note.en: From PostgreSQL until visible in Greenplum, versus the previous daily batch ETL
note.id: Dari PostgreSQL sampai terlihat di Greenplum, dibandingkan batch ETL harian sebelumnya
